text:
tara: FYI opened a tiny PR to fix console observability examples. playground charts are blank and tracehook snippets throw on init. hoping for quick review as it's blocking a customer sandbox. :grimacing:

devin: link? saw blank panels in the preview earlier.

tara: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5599 
summary: replace legacy metric name `latency_ms` -> `p50_latency_ms`, add `p95_latency_ms` as collapsed extra_series; rename tracehook param `trace_id_header` -> `trace_key_header` in samples; add a short troubleshooting note.

olga: paste the before/after so I can skim fast.

tara: old panel:```yaml
- type: timeseries
  query: avg(latency_ms{service=\"console\"}) by (route)
  label: latency_ms
```
new panel:```yaml
- type: timeseries
  query: avg(p50_latency_ms{service=\"console\"}) by (route)
  label: p50_latency_ms
- type: timeseries
  query: avg(p95_latency_ms{service=\"console\"}) by (route)
  label: p95_latency_ms
  display: extra_series
```

 tara: tracehook snippet (py) old->new:```python
# old
TraceHook(header='x-rw-trace', trace_id_header='x-rw-trace')
# new
TraceHook(header='x-rw-trace', trace_key_header='x-rw-trace-key')
# note: trace_id_header accepted as deprecated shim
```

samir: UX: include one line under the chart: "p50 = typical latency, p95 = tail; keep p95 collapsed to reduce chart noise." Add troubleshooting: "blank panels => check exporter metric names."

olga: also remove an external blog link that returned 410 in the guide, replace with internal perf primer.

docs-bot: CI: linkcheck failed at /console/observability/old-latency (404). Linter: deprecated-field `latency_ms` used in examples/dashboard_examples.yaml.

tara: added redirect note for infra and swapped the 410 link. pushed updates. PTAL @devin @olga

devin: LGTM, minor nit about YAML quoting.

olga: approved. :+1:

docs-bot: PR merged by tara (docs CI: success)  site deploy scheduled for 2026-04-20 02:00 UTC

tara: thanks everyone, closing thread. will coordinate the redirect landing after deploy.
